source.name: Escape in a nested menubar submenu must close only that submenu and return focus to its parent item
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/NickDJM/accessible-menu/issues/533) at 4b8e65db81f40c0c032db1c8567615bbe3da32f6. Blind to the maintainers' fix cfb4dc85f57e59c3e1ca3c8835618101a6e818b9; routing auto.

journey.title: Escape closes only the innermost open submenu
journey.goal: Escape in the Facts submenu returns to Facts while the About submenu stays open

functionalJourney.title: Open nested submenus with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: About and Facts submenus open on click

guards.title: Escape in a first-level submenu returns to the menubar
guards.goal: Escape in the About submenu closes it and focuses About

plan.root_cause: The Escape key handler in a submenu (non-top-level menubar) incorrectly closed all submenus of the root menu and focused the root menu's current child, instead of closing only the current submenu and focusing its parent menu item.
plan.repair_strategy: Replace the Escape key handler in the submenu to close the current submenu via its toggle (located in the parent menu item) and then focus the parent menu item.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape in the Facts submenu will close only the Facts submenu, move focus to the Facts item (which remains in the About submenu), and leave the About submenu open.
functional_risks: If the parent menu item lacks a toggle (unexpected for a submenu item), the submenu may not close.
If the parent menu's current menu item is not the controller of the current submenu (due to prior state corruption), the wrong submenu might be closed.
The guard clause (if parentMenuItem && parentMenuItem.elements.toggle) prevents errors but may leave the submenu open if the toggle is missing.
verification_requirements: After the change, journey step 5 (Escape in Facts submenu) must pass: focus on #facts, aria-expanded of #facts false, aria-expanded of #about true.
Verify that pressing Escape in a submenu when no submenu is open does nothing (no error).
Verify that the About submenu remains operable after closing the Facts submenu (e.g., ArrowDown still opens Overview).
Verify that Escape in the About submenu (when Facts is closed) still closes About and returns focus to the menubar.
